grader_history.summary: Graph is largely faithful with no hallucinations, but has 3 WEAK_EVIDENCE relations where truncated quotes discard the 'governor' assertion (Rick Scott, Scott Walker, Jack Markell), omits 2 of the 11 election states (Indiana, Missouri) and key candidates (Pat McCrory, Maggie Hassan, etc.), and omits CANDIDATE_FOR relations for Steve Bullock and Rob McKenna that are stated between entities already in the graph.

Graph is substantially faithful after revision: type vocabulary (GOVERNOR_OF, CANDIDATE_FOR, ATTORNEY_GENERAL_OF, LIEUTENANT_GOVERNOR_OF) is now distinct, apt, and consistently applied; evidence quotes are verbatim and support their facts; no hallucinations, contradictions, or dangling references found. Remaining defects are omissions: two materially important candidates in the three competitive races (Rick Hill - Montana, Ovide Lamontagne - New Hampshire) are missing as entities, and the existing entity Walter Dalton lacks the CANDIDATE_FOR North Carolina relation explicitly stated in the documents.
